meta.name: Launch off-boarding access reviews with Probo, email and Slack

name: Template Probo - Off-boarding launch Access Review automatically

parameters.content:
## Template Probo - Off-boarding launch Access Review automatically

### How it works

This workflow listens for Probo user webhooks, normalizes the incoming payload, and only continues when the event represents an off-boarding. It creates and starts a Probo access review campaign using connected access review sources, alerts Slack about any disconnected sources, then waits for Probo to fetch access data. After reading the campaign entries, it emails relevant tool admins and posts a Slack recap of the off-boarding access review.

### Setup steps

- Configure the Probo credentials used by the Probo nodes and ensure the webhook URL is registered in Probo for user lifecycle events.
- Edit the “Settings (edit me)” node with the fallback admin email, sender email, Slack recap channel ID, and Slack alert channel ID.
- Configure the email sending credentials for the “Email each tool admin” node and verify the sender address is allowed.
- Configure Slack credentials for both Slack nodes and confirm the bot can post to the configured channels.
- Review the wait duration to ensure Probo has enough time to fetch access data before the campaign entries are read.

### Customization

Adjust the off-boarding detection logic, campaign settings, notification copy, Slack channels, fallback recipients, and wait time to match your organization’s HRIS/webhook payloads and review process.

## Receive off-boarding event

Accepts the Probo user webhook, normalizes the payload, and determines whether the event is an off-boarding before branching.

## Ignore other events

Stops processing for webhook events that are not identified as off-boarding events.

## Configure and create review

Applies editable workflow settings, creates a Probo access review campaign, and retrieves available access review sources.

## Filter review sources

Splits the returned source list into individual items and checks which sources are connected versus broken.

## Alert disconnected sources

Aggregates disconnected access review sources and posts a Slack alert so tools can be reconnected.

## Launch connected review

Collects connected source IDs, updates the Probo campaign with those sources, starts the campaign, and waits for Probo to fetch access data.

## Fetch campaign entries

Retrieves the access review campaign after the wait period and reads its access entries for downstream notifications.

## Notify admins and Slack

Builds two notification outputs from the campaign entries: emails each relevant tool admin and posts a recap message to Slack.
